info.name: library-api
info.description:
Requests for the library management REST API. Select the "library-api local" environment before sending.

Run the "Auth" folder first: it logs in as the administrator (adminEmail and adminPassword in the environment, the same as ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env), registers a new member and logs in as that member. The login requests save the tokens into the environment (adminToken, memberToken, and token for the last login). Every request sends "Authorization: Bearer <token>": the collection uses {{token}}, the catalogue and admin folders {{adminToken}}, the Loans folder {{memberToken}}.
